findings.summary: crates/server/tests/github_app.rs:an_expiring_token_is_replaced_and_every_token_is_counted: the test plan says a token 'within the 5 minute margin' is replaced, but the fake's EXPIRED token expires in 2000. With MARGIN set to 0 in github_app.rs, all 6 tests still pass. The margin does work (my scratch test: a token 200 s out was replaced, one 400 s out was kept), but nothing guards it. A mode that mints a token expiring a few minutes out would.
Test plan for AC-5 says the tests/github.rs cases pass with Auth::Token; every GitHub::new there passes None. No test asserts the personal token is sent as the bearer (seen only in my e2e run).

crates/server/src/github_app.rs token(): if getting a new token fails while the cached one is inside the 5-minute margin but still valid, the read fails instead of using the cached token. Seen in e2e: a 500 from access_tokens failed bbooth/secret's read while its last token still had about 270 s to live.

evidence: AC-1 test crates/server/tests/github_app.rs:a_private_repo_reads_as_the_app_every_minute: PASS (1 passed, 5 filtered out); fails with the JWT iss changed, with the token kept over the App, and with Auth::App given the tokenless interval

AC-1 e2e cargo-built board-server with GITHUB_APP_ID=42 and the fixture key, against a Python fake of GitHub and Linear that verifies the JWT with the key's public half and 404s bbooth/secret without a live installation token; GET /v1/snapshot: TRU-5 card for bbooth/secret has pr #1 'TRU-5: Secret work', checks pass, and gate Build round 1 pass. The fake's log shows the JWT on /repos/bbooth/secret/installation and /app/installations/7/access_tokens, then ghs_ tokens on pulls, check-runs and contents. Reads of the open-PR list came at t=208.6, 268.6 and 328.7 (every 60 s)

AC-2 test crates/server/tests/github_app.rs:an_expiring_token_is_replaced_and_every_token_is_counted: PASS; fails when tokens are never refreshed and when result="error" isn't counted; still passes with MARGIN=0

AC-2 e2e running server with the fake minting tokens that expire 330 s out and rejecting them after expiry; then token minting failing (500); then back to hour-long tokens; GET /metrics and /v1/snapshot: A new token was minted on each one-minute read (each had 270 s left, inside the margin), board_github_app_tokens_total{result="ok"} went 1->3, and the reads succeeded with no restart. While minting failed, result="error" went to 2 (the read plus its retry), bbooth/secret failed that read and kept its earlier PR on the board. On the next read ok went to 4, last_good advanced, and the PR was read again
AC-2 inspection scratch test in a worktree (not committed): tokens expiring now+200 s and now+400 s: 200 s: mints went 5 -> 8 across two reads (replaced); 400 s: mints stayed 1 -> 1 (kept)
AC-3 test crates/server/tests/github_app.rs:a_repo_the_app_isnt_on_fails_alone_and_no_secret_shows: PASS; fails when the 404 message is changed to a generic 'GitHub {path}: 404'

AC-3 e2e board.toml with bbooth/elsewhere (installation lookup 404) and bbooth/secret; GET /v1/snapshot: the github source's last_error is "PR lists failed for bbooth/elsewhere; 1 reads failed, first: the GitHub App isn't installed on bbooth/elsewhere (no earlier PRs)", and bbooth/secret's TRU-5 PR, checks and gate still show

AC-4 e2e cargo-built board-server started with bad App settings (GITHUB_TOKEN also set): exit 1 with: ID only -> 'GITHUB_APP_ID is set but GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY isn't'; key only -> 'GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is set but GITHUB_APP_ID isn't'; ID 'forty' or '-1' -> 'GITHUB_APP_ID isn't a number'; damaged PEM, 'garbage-not-a-key', or a PEM with literal \n -> 'GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY isn't an RSA private key in PEM form'; an RSA public key -> 'GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY can't sign: is it the App's RSA key?'. No key or token text in any output

AC-5 e2e board-server with only GITHUB_TOKEN set, then with no GitHub settings (env -u), then with both the App and GITHUB_TOKEN set: Token only: every GitHub request carried 'Bearer github_pat…', open-PR lists came 60 s apart, no installation or access_tokens calls, and /metrics had no board_github_app_tokens_total. Neither set: requests had no Authorization header, and it logged WARN 'GITHUB_TOKEN is not set: reading public repos only as often as 45 requests an hour allows'. Both set: it logged WARN 'GITHUB_TOKEN is ignored: signing in as the GitHub App', and GitHub saw only JWTs and ghs_ tokens, never the PAT
